purpose: Lead-level semantic, governance, deployment and integration notes that sit above the detailed Returns and Claims control plane.

semantic_keys.name: Returns order reason
semantic_keys.meaning: Why the return business transaction exists at header/commercial level.
semantic_keys.do_not_confuse_with: item return reason or inspection result

semantic_keys.name: Return reason
semantic_keys.meaning: Why the customer returns this item, for example damage or defect. Useful for customer-facing root-cause analytics.

semantic_keys.name: Inspection code
semantic_keys.meaning: What was physically found during inspection. It is evidence for disposition and refund, not merely another complaint reason.

semantic_keys.name: Logistical follow-up activity
semantic_keys.meaning: What physically happens next to the returned quantity.

semantic_keys.name: Refund type
semantic_keys.meaning: What the customer receives: money by credit memo or a replacement product.

semantic_keys.name: Refund control
semantic_keys.meaning: When/how the selected compensation is executed: defer, start approved flow, immediate, or no refund.

semantic_keys.name: Refund code
semantic_keys.meaning: Commercial extent of the credit, typically a percentage used in refund determination.

architecture_traps.title: Goods receipt is not ownership
architecture_traps.problem: A warehouse user sees stock and assumes the company owns it.
architecture_traps.design_rule: Model physical custody and valuation/ownership separately. Deferred returns can first enter non-valuated returns stock.

architecture_traps.title: Refund can trigger valuation
architecture_traps.problem: Customer service refunds early and inventory value changes before the intended final disposition.
architecture_traps.design_rule: Decide whether valuation should happen at refund or only after final logistical follow-up; use valuation suspension only with an explicit policy.

architecture_traps.title: Approval workflow vs billing block
architecture_traps.problem: Teams configure a billing block on credit/debit memo request type and also expect sales-document approval workflow to start.
architecture_traps.design_rule: Choose the governance model deliberately. SAP documents that credit/debit memo request approval workflow requires no billing block on the relevant document type for the workflow to start.

architecture_traps.title: One generic reason field destroys analytics
architecture_traps.problem: Customer reason, physical finding, disposition and refund are stored as if they were one classification.
architecture_traps.design_rule: Keep return reason, inspection code, follow-up activity and refund decision as separate dimensions.

architecture_traps.title: API version is an architecture choice
architecture_traps.problem: An integration design says 'Customer Return API' without checking required features.
architecture_traps.design_rule: Check V2/V4/A2A capability by use case. Current V4 focuses on standard CBAR and adds capabilities such as AVC and automatic inspection; V2 supports CBAR/CBRE and approval release/reject. Do not assume feature parity.

architecture_traps.title: Repair capability is not the same as app availability
architecture_traps.problem: A process is declared unsupported because one UI cannot select the repair follow-up in one release/context.
architecture_traps.design_rule: Separate business capability, follow-up activity, app support and release restriction. Verify the chosen UI and deployment.

architecture_traps.title: Configurable returns have follow-up restrictions
architecture_traps.problem: A generic ARM design is copied to configurable products.
architecture_traps.design_rule: Treat 7KW / configurable-material returns as a distinct edge. SAP documents restrictions for free-stock transfers and Service repair follow-ups because configuration data must remain consistent.

valuation_design.when: Normal returns valuation policy is acceptable.
valuation_design.question: Is material-master valuation the correct economic basis for the returned product?

valuation_design.when: The business wants the return valuation tied to the preceding sales transaction where supported/configured.
valuation_design.question: Do we need the historical sales context to value the returned product rather than only current material valuation?

valuation_design.when: Refund timing should not automatically decide ownership/valuation.
valuation_design.question: Which event is the legal/economic ownership trigger: refund, inspection decision, or final disposition?

ewm_inspection_modes.sequence: Returns order → inspection/decision in S/4HANA → follow-on document → EWM execution
ewm_inspection_modes.best_when: ARM owns the decision centrally and EWM mainly executes warehouse steps.

ewm_inspection_modes.mode: Inspection during goods receipt in decentralized EWM/QIE
ewm_inspection_modes.sequence: Returns order → EWM receipt/inspection → simple local follow-up or transfer complex decision back to S/4HANA
ewm_inspection_modes.best_when: Warehouse inspection belongs operationally in EWM and high-volume execution benefits from local decisions.

api_choice.good_for: New standard-return integrations, CBAR, AVC-related needs, automatic inspection flags, synchronous/asynchronous processing
api_choice.watch: Current feature set does not equal V2; approval release/reject is not supported in the same way.

api_choice.good_for: Existing integrations, CBAR/CBRE and scenarios requiring release/reject of returns orders in approval
api_choice.watch: SAP recommends V4 for new projects and new capabilities are added there.

api_choice.good_for: Asynchronous application-to-application integration and controlled external number/message processing
api_choice.watch: Different reference and object-processing limits from A2X.

api_choice.good_for: External inspection applications, inspection documents and inspection split items
api_choice.watch: It owns inspection data, not the whole returns orchestration.

api_choice.interface: Credit Memo Request A2X OData V4
api_choice.good_for: External creation/update of commercial credit claims
api_choice.watch: Reference/copying and approval status remain business controls, not API transport details.

deployment_specific_edges.note: On-premise/private documentation includes refund control A (after receipt of credit memo) for selected forwarding scenarios such as another company code or supplier. Public-cloud standard descriptions focus mainly on R/P/I/N. Treat A as deployment/process-specific, not a universal mnemonic.

Older or deployment-specific ARM documentation can expose repair activities such as 0016/0017 in addition to newer Service integration 0026. Verify release, active business functions and target Service architecture before teaching a code as universal.

Follow-up activities 0002/0011 can lose access to variant configuration data for inventory management, and Service repair follow-ups have documented restrictions. Keep configurable returns as a separate design check.
